evals.prompt: Rule 155 ke tehat Local Purchase Committee kitne members ka hota hai?
evals.expected_output: The verbatim text of Rule 155 and its three sub-rules, stating a three-member Local Purchase Committee of an appropriate level as decided by the Head of the Department, with the Hinglish explanation.
expectations: The skill runs scripts/gfr_lookup.py rule 155 rather than answering from memory
The answer states three members and attributes the level decision to the Head of the Department
The Rs 50,000 to Rs 5,00,000 band is quoted with the condition that the item is not available on GeM
The Scientific Ministries exception (Rs 2,00,000 to Rs 25,00,000, OM dated 05.06.2025) is mentioned

evals.prompt: Bid security kitne din tak valid rehta hai, aur unsuccessful bidders ko kab tak wapas milta hai?
evals.expected_output: Rule 170 quoted verbatim: bid security ordinarily 2% to 5% of estimated value, valid forty-five days beyond the final bid validity period, returned to unsuccessful bidders latest by the 30th day after award, with MSE and DPIIT-recognised startups exempt.
expectations: The skill searches first, then runs rule 170
The answer states forty-five days beyond final bid validity, not a generic period
The answer states the 30th day after award for return to unsuccessful bidders
The 2% to 5% range and the MSE/Startup exemption are included
No figure is stated that does not appear in the verbatim text

evals.prompt: Rule 206 ke according to non-consulting services ke liye kaunse rules apply hote hain agar Rules 198-205 mein cover na ho?
evals.expected_output: Rule 206 quoted verbatim, stating that such circumstances fall back to Rules 142 to 176 pertaining to procurement of goods, and not to the procurement of consulting services.
expectations: The answer says Rules 142 to 176, the goods rules
The answer explicitly excludes the consulting-services rules
The answer does not cite Rules 135 to 176, which is a known error in one of the comic episodes that was fixed
The verbatim wording is quoted rather than paraphrased

evals.prompt: Mujhe Rs 3 lakh ka equipment kharidna hai, GeM par available nahi hai. Kaunsa rule aur kya procedure?
evals.expected_output: Rule 155 identified, with the verbatim band above Rs 50,000 and up to Rs 5,00,000, the three-member Local Purchase Committee, the market survey, and the joint certificate, plus the GeM condition.
expectations: The skill searches for the band and identifies Rule 155
The answer explains the Local Purchase Committee route rather than an advertised tender
The answer notes the condition that the item is not available on GeM
The answer mentions the joint certificate the committee members must record
The answer does not invent a procedure not present in the rule

evals.prompt: Can you tell me the debarment period under Rule 151?
evals.expected_output: Rule 151 quoted verbatim: up to three years on conviction, up to two years for breach of the code of integrity, a reasonable opportunity to be heard, and publication on CPPP.
expectations: The skill runs rule 151 rather than recalling the periods
The three-year and two-year structure is stated distinctly
The requirement to give a reasonable opportunity to represent is mentioned
The DoE list on CPPP is mentioned
